paper-white.$description: Paper White — Text on dark buttons, pill button backgrounds.

line.$description: Line — Borders for headers, ghost buttons, and dividers.

subtext.$description: Subtext — Secondary text, navigation links, placeholder text.

icon.$description: Icon — Inactive icons and tertiary UI elements.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, headlines, and primary button backgrounds.

onyx.$description: Onyx — Logo, icons, highest contrast text.

geistsans.$description: The universal font for all UI text, from body copy to display headings. Weight 600 is used for major headlines, 500 for buttons, and 400 for body text. Its signature is the aggressive negative letter-spacing at large sizes, creating dense, block-like headlines.

geistmono.$description: Used for small, technical annotations or user statistics where tabular alignment is beneficial.
